about_the_game:
Each day you will open you store, check your textile supply, drink your morning coffee and get to work. Earn money from selling suits to purchase better textile, upgrade your machines and tools, and of course pay rent and taxes.

Suits will start from a roll of textile of your choosing, different textiles such as cotton or wool are good for different parts of the suit, or for a different occasion/style. Some are more expensive than others so be careful. You can order custom designs as well. You will unlock more materials and patterns/colors as you gain reputation.

Cut the textile into squares and put them on the table. You can make Jackets, Shirts and Pants ,(Female Dresses maybe*), and you can combine those parts on a Mannequin to create a whole suit. 

Each customer will want a suit or a part of one for their needed occasion and style, and in the customers size as well. If the customer doesn't know their size, measure!

Make sure to get to them in time as they can leave and decrease your reputation. They will usually come for an order and return the next day for it. If you have too much business you can raise your prices to reduce customers to your wanted level. You could also do the opposite.

From funerals to parties, from old school to contemporary suits, you will be required to know the themes and styles in order to make fashionable decisions. 

Making good fashion decisions will raise your reputations and attract more customers, and better paying ones. Famous people will start coming in with specific requests, and you better deliver. More fame will also attract better suppliers which will give you more textile types and designs.

name: Tailor Town
short_description: Run a tailoring shop in this cozy business sim. Create custom textiles and suits for different occasions and customers. Survive the economy and raise the status of your shop by creating sought after stiles, upgrade your tools and move to a better location to attract better clientele.
